name: Mantovani Eis
kurzbeschreibung: **Enjoy authentic Mantovani Eis in Telfs!** Indulge in the creamy, velvety ice cream from the famous Italian gelato tradition, crafted with love in the heart of **Tirol**. Whether you prefer classic flavors like vanilla and hazelnut or unique creations such as Kaiserschmarrn or Apfelstrudel, every scoop is a taste of pure happiness. Visit **Mantovani Eis** in Telfs and let yourself be enchanted by the irresistible charm of this Italian ice cream artistry!
